plan.title: feat(skills): deft-directive-portfolio-priority — agent skill for #3198 priority briefs

narratives.Description: Implement the agent skill and discoverability pointers for the portfolio prioritization pass defined by #3198. From local github-issue cache plus classify partition, produce a propose-not-apply priority brief with epistemic gates, then hand off for operator dispose. #3198 owns process and dogfood; this issue owns the re-runnable skill entrypoint. Worked example: #3200 / docs/analysis/2026-08-07-portfolio-priority-brief-patterns-pilot.md.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want a discoverable deft-directive-portfolio-priority skill that produces verified priority briefs from the local issue cache, so that fresh agent sessions re-run portfolio prioritization without reinventing the pilot.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Create content/skills/deft-directive-portfolio-priority/SKILL.md with triggers (portfolio priority, competing RFCs, priority brief, cluster open issues), ordered phases, and RFC2119 MUST gates: cache freshness disclose, triage:classify --mirror as partition only, theme slice, cluster/conflict matrix/shortlist/park, epistemic verify via gh api or fresh cache, emit markdown template matching docs/analysis/2026-08-07-portfolio-priority-brief-patterns-pilot.md sections, dispose checklist to #1396/plan-sequence. 2. Register skill in content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json and run task packs:render; wire Skills Index via content/REFERENCES.md. 3. Optional one-line see-also in content/commands.md triage section. 4. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] for #3201. 5. Content-contract pins under packages/core/src/content-contracts/skills if required by pack. Verify: task packs:render; npm test -w @deftai/directive-core -- --run content-contracts/skills. Do not re-spec #3198 process; do not edit packages/core/src/triage/classify/label-mirror.ts.
narratives.Labels: enhancement, meta, triage, agent-experience, process, status:child

narrative.Acceptance: Given pack render and Skills Index/REFERENCES conventions, when agents scan for portfolio priority triggers, then deft-directive-portfolio-priority (or final name) is discoverable.
Given the SKILL.md, when followed, then classify is filter-only, every cited issue is verified and bodies read, and title-only supersession is forbidden.
Given a skill run, when the brief is emitted, then it includes scope counts, interrupt vs portfolio, family matrix, shortlist, park, epistemic limits, and dispose checklist; links #3200 pilot path.
Given the skill, when used, then no SCM label writes, no triage:accept, no scope lifecycle; CHANGELOG cites #3201.

swarm.missing_traces_justification: Skill-only PR. #3198 process/dogfood and #3200 pilot brief are siblings — do not re-own pilot docs PR unless coordinating. Exclusive of label-mirror code (#3197 done).
